quarterly_data.quarter: Hyosung Heavy Industries DART supply contract (09-15-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Two US extra-high-voltage transformer supply contracts signed 09-14-2026 with Hyosung's US sales subsidiary HICO America Sales & Tech for projects it won (end customers not disclosed): (1) 765kV Transformer Purchase Agreement - 765kV transformers and reactors to build a 765kV grid in part of the US, USD 163,451,870 (KRW 220,071,597,768, 3.69% of 2025 consolidated revenue), term 09-14-2026 to 02-28-2029; (2) 345kV Transformer Purchase Agreement - USD 123,679,452 (KRW 166,522,014,173, 2.79% of 2025 consolidated revenue), term 09-14-2026 to 08-31-2028. Payment is billed as supply progresses; no down payment.
quarterly_data.counterparty: HICO America Sales & Tech (Hyosung US sales subsidiary; end customers undisclosed)
